svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: langgraph-beads-memory's memory mechanism. User messages and the agent's final answer are captured as facts automatically, verbatim, with no extraction LLM. Facts live on a session_id that spans multiple threads, so a new thread starts warm instead of cold — the checkpointer's thread_id resets each conversation but the memory scope does not. A supervisor forks each sub-agent an isolated, hash-suffixed child namespace; a sub-agent reads its ancestors' facts but never its siblings'. Each sub-agent must call conclude_task — one summary fact rolls up to the parent, linked by rollup_of edges to the raw exploration for audit; if a sub-agent crashes before concluding, the wrapper synthesizes a 'task did not complete' fact so the delegated task never vanishes silently. A revised constraint supersedes the stale fact, which flips to superseded — retired from retrieval, kept for audit. A later conversation on a new thread recalls only active facts by similarity, injected with short ids the agent can cite. Across three measured runs the treatment carried a budget revision across two thread boundaries in two of them, while the baseline never mentioned a budget figure at all, and it did so using about 36 percent fewer input tokens per call, not more.
svg.title: langgraph-beads-memory: the mechanism, in full

extraction store: nothing marks which value is current
1 · Capture — every user message and the turn's final answer become facts automatically. No extraction LLM; nothing invented, nothing dropped.
2 · The crux: facts live on a session_id spanning many threads. The checkpointer's thread_id resets each conversation — this scope doesn't.
3 · A brand-new thread starts warm: top-K relevant facts are recalled by similarity and injected with short ids the agent can cite.
4 · Delegation forks each sub-agent its own hash-suffixed namespace. It reads its ancestors' facts, never its siblings'.
5 · Sub-agents explore in isolation; siblings never see each other's work. If one crashes before concluding, nothing is lost.
6 · conclude_task enforced: one summary per sub-agent, rollup_of to raw exploration. A crash yields a synthesized fallback fact, not silence.
7 · A correction supersedes the stale fact via a typed edge — it flips to superseded, retired from retrieval, kept for audit.
8 · Another new thread recalls only active facts — superseded values can't reach the model. The agent cites them by short id.
9 · Measured (N=3): treatment carried the $50k revision across threads 2/3 runs; baseline never cited a budget. And it used ~36% FEWER input tokens.
10 · One typed fact graph: capture, session scope, recall, fork, enforced rollup, supersede — every edge audit-able end to end.
Capture → session scope → recall → fork → enforced rollup (with crash fallback) → supersede → recall & cite. One typed fact graph, audit-able end to end.
